description.en-US: A mod to make Traumasoft mobile-friendly. Works with Safari on iPhone or Firefox on Android. Post-Traumatic puts the most-used options directly in the top bar and restructures the schedule, work order, checklist, and punch clock pages for dramatically increased usability. It also lets the log-in page remember your username after the first time it's typed. The rest of the site is unchanged.

release_notes.en-US: The Base dropdown starts on All bases on every page load instead of remembering the last choice.
